parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Translation $\binom10$ and stretch factor $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Translation $\binom10$ — B1. Guidance: allow shift by $1$ in the $x$-direction/horizontally; “translation by 1 to the right” alone scores B0. Stretch — B1; factor $2$ in the $y$-direction, parallel to the $y$-axis, vertically, or with $x$-axis invariant — B1. “Factor 2 upwards” alone scores B0. Transformations may be in either order. Total: 3.
